files.name: uav-silm-software-2.0.0.zip
files.what: Ground Station (laptop), Raspberry Pi software, ArduPilot settings and GPS-loss script, simulator tools, documentation and tests.

files.name: silm-oi-farm-model-v1.zip
files.what: The ready-made recognition model only (tractor, car, truck, livestock), with labels and its description.

files.name: gps_denied_failsafe.param
files.what: ArduPlane parameters: no-RC operation and all failsafes ending in the automatic landing. Load in Mission Planner or QGroundControl.

files.name: silm_gps_loss.lua
files.what: ArduPilot Lua script: GPS lost, jammed or spoofed - stop trusting GPS and land on dead reckoning. Copy to APM/scripts on the SD card.
